description: DeepKeep guardrails for moderation and redaction

description.text: Moderate prompts and responses with DeepKeep and optionally redact modified content.

firewallId.description: Default firewall id to use for both hooks.

inputFirewallId.label: Input Firewall ID

outputFirewallId.label: Output Firewall ID

failOpen.label: Fail Open
